exposure: delivery ball combined with free position midwifery nursing
cohort: 110 primipara admitted to the department of gynecology and obstetrics from August 2017 to August 2018
finding: Delivery ball combined with free position delivery can help primipara relieve pain, improve comfort, reduce postpartum hemorrhage, shorten labor duration, and improve delivery outcomes.
mod_finding: The intervention group (delivery ball and free position delivery nursing) had a significantly lower cesarean delivery rate compared to the control group.
